test_title: PYST 36: SSC GD Constable 2025 - Reasoning (Held On: 20 Feb, 2025 - Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: 'NZRB' is related to 'LXOY' in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, 'VJAT' is related to 'THXQ'. To which of the following is "PGXL' related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0270f2b5240d1e3915517248ac98d6d73ad611166857551401277421991a6c6e.png] 

Logic: The pattern is: **-2, -2, -3, -3**.

'NZRB' is related to 'LXOY'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e6fb587eb2889c94c157c5696c2e2b024bbc504935478e2d6a93045eb13731e.png] 

 'VJAT' is related to 'THXQ'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4df37217dc07179fcbed6417f185f5ac0e6e7713e4f7444821a846568b90462f.png] 

Similarly, 'PGXL' is coded:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/055eaede0bfd6fe9682aed485b956b6ba040ca5bbbc15c05c293ce64887fe1c8.png] 

So, The letter-cluster that **PGXL** is related to is **NEUI.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
